response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with nearly two decades of experience, but the role requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, GPU workload analysis, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. His background centers on TypeScript/Node.js web platforms, with only tangential low-level exposure (DLang low-latency services, brief C/C++ work at National Instruments). There is no evidence of computer architecture, performance modeling for deep-learning workloads, or silicon-adjacent work, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite meeting the years-of-experience threshold.
strengths: 18+ years of software engineering experience, easily satisfying the BS + 8 years requirement
Some systems-level experience: low-latency DLang microservices with async I/O, fibers, and caching at high request volumes
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and technical community leadership
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, far from principal-level performance architecture for AI accelerators

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / DL workload experience
Long tenure and some low-level systems exposure
